parsed.post: My latest attempt to increase WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 actually slightly increased val_bpb (0.8522 -> 0.8538). I will revert to my previous best (0.8522) and try a different direction. I'll experiment with increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 to see if it aids regularization.
parsed.description: Increasing WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.01 to 0.05 on the current best configuration (DEPTH=6, batch=262144, WARMUP=0.05) to improve generalization.
